findings.description: Internal contradiction: Hard Contract says NEVER commit, but On Start step 6 and On Completion step 4 still show git add -A and git commit commands. A worker agent following numbered steps could issue commits despite the Hard Contract. The contract is present, labeled non-negotiable, and the historical context cites real incidents, which mitigates the risk. However the contradicting protocol body steps were not removed, making Loop 065 deliverable only partially satisfied.
findings.evidence: ralph-loop-worker.md line 97: git add -A and git commit checkpoint; line 183: git add -A and git commit complete. Hard Contract at lines 20-37 says NEVER commit. core/agents/worker.md same contradiction at lines 36 and 234 vs Hard Contract at line 250.

findings.description: Echo redirect to .advanced-plans/logs/execution.log uses a shell redirect (>>) which technically contradicts Hard Contract guard (b) (Write/Edit tools only, no shell redirects). However this is a relative-path log append to the designated logs directory, distinguishable from the Windows-path junk-file scenario the guard was written to prevent. Advisory only.
findings.evidence: Line 101: echo ... >> .advanced-plans/logs/execution.log is a shell redirect. Guard (b) states Write/Edit tools only, never shell redirects.
